blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — More than P1.43 billion in financial assistance has been released to 139,833 sugarcane farmers and laborers affected by the red-striped soft-scale insect (RSSI) infestation in the Negros Island Region, Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Regional Director Arwin Razo said on Sunday.
